# Local map dependencies

These files are kept in the repository so the interactive map works on GitHub Pages and in a local `file://` preview without a CDN request.

- `d3-7.9.0.min.js`: D3 7.9.0, from [d3/d3](https://github.com/d3/d3/tree/v7.9.0), license in `D3-LICENSE.txt`.
- `topojson-client-3.1.0.min.js`: topojson-client 3.1.0, from [topojson/topojson-client](https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client/tree/v3.1.0), license in `TOPOJSON-LICENSE.txt`.
- `world-atlas-50m-2.0.2.js`: countries-50m boundaries from [topojson/world-atlas](https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas/tree/v2.0.2), exposed as `window.worldAtlasData`, license in `WORLD-ATLAS-LICENSE.txt`.
